counter_struct.Name: OsIfCounterConfig_0

OsIfSystemTimerClockRef.description: Populated array referencing an existing Mcu McuClockReferencePoint. ConfigTools uses this ArraySetting to resolve the system timer clock source. Discovery prefers the reference point whose McuClockFrequencySelect==CORE_CLK; if none has CORE_CLK, the first reference point is used. Path format: /Mcu/Mcu/McuModuleConfiguration/<ClockSettingName>/<PointName>.
OsIfSystemTimerClockRef.serialization: Non-self-closed <array name="OsIfSystemTimerClockRef"> with one child <setting name="0" value="<REF_PATH>"/>

OsIfSystemTimerClockFreq.description: ConfigTools component type is ArraySetting (not ScalarSetting). When OsIfSystemTimerClockRef is populated, this field must be an EMPTY array. Writing it as a scalar <setting name="OsIfSystemTimerClockFreq" value="..."/> is silently rejected by ConfigTools and causes SEVERE: Either OsIfSystemTimerClockRef or OsIfSystemTimerClockFreq must be enabled in baremetal mode.
OsIfSystemTimerClockFreq.source_ref: BaseNXP.xdm:OsIfCounterConfig/OsIfSystemTimerClockFreq; verified via ConfigTools [SDK/DATA] type log and vendor .mex examples

counter_struct.mutual_exclusion: In baremetal, OsIfSystemTimerClockRef (populated) satisfies the constraint; OsIfSystemTimerClockFreq stays an empty array. Both are serialized as arrays -- never as scalar <setting> elements.
